reviews.t: Only organic products inside and outside my body.
reviews.x: I gave 4 stars only because of one issue. I am a 72 year young senior and I would suggest a slight change in packaging. The bottle gets very slippery because of it's smooth as glass surface and slippage causing foot injury is a real possibility. I love the shampoo because it does the job on my scalp ( notice I did not say hair) and the little hair I have left. without chemicals. We all know that cancer is aggravated if not caused by chemicals, so organic is the way to go especially for children.

reviews.t: Great product for all hair types!

The product lathers very well and rinses very clean and leaves a great scent.  I am very excited about trying all the products in this line!!!! I have read they will be coming out with a conditioner soon I will be first in line to purchase that.

reviews.x: We have tried lots of different products for our 3 kiddos that have always had sensitive skin/eczema patches. Aveeno, Johnsons and Johnsons sensitive and various natural/organic online products (not sold in stores that I have seen). This is the first one that actually smells good (their hair smells nice after washing, unlike many of the other "natural" or organic products). Plus, their skin is finally clear!! I use it for myself and I've been very happy with it. Cutting out all of the sulfates, parabens, etc. has REALLY helped my hair and I wash my hair everyday. Much less breakage.  I just wish the bottle were bigger, because you tend to use more than the over-the-counter stuff, which have all of the lathering agents (sulfates).
...and the fact that it's safe for my baby's skin?  Non-negotiable!  Thank you Sweet Baby for making a wonderful product that I can feel good about using!

reviews.t: Love this product. Natural product for my children that smells great!

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the shampoo for being gentle and effective on sensitive skin, including children with eczema and scalp issues.
Many customers highlight that it is sulfate-free and free of other harsh ingredients, which they credit with improving hair health and reducing breakage.
The coconut scent is widely loved for smelling great without being overpowering.
Several reviewers note the product lathers and rinses well despite being sulfate-free.
A few customers mention drawbacks: one found it dried out their hair, and another wished for larger or less slippery packaging.
